issues.claim: Saree Bazar, 1384 Oak Tree Rd, town = Edison
issues.problem: Wrong town. Its own site and directories place it at 1384 Oak Tree Rd, Iselin, NJ 08830 (Woodbridge Township), not Edison. The mapper's only source (two-pos.com) returned HTTP 403 and its note admitted the township was unconfirmed.
issues.fix: Drop from the Edison zone or move to the Woodbridge/Iselin zone.

issues.claim: Oak Tree Jewelers, 1655 Oak Tree Rd Ste 235, Edison - active (source: MapQuest listing)
issues.problem: A YellowPages listing for the same name/address marks the business CLOSED, and no current operating evidence could be found; the cited MapQuest page could not be opened (extraction failed), so the sole source is unverifiable.
issues.fix: Remove, or re-verify by phone/in person before any outreach; do not treat MapQuest as activity evidence.

issues.claim: Lou Rose Music Center, 1627 State Route 27, Edison - active (family-run since the 1940s)
issues.problem: Reported closed: a 2023 local newspaper describes it as a 'now closed' store and a 2025 local discussion says it is 'long gone'. The website in the entry, www.lourosemusic.com, does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND). Its phone 732-985-3333 is the same number listed for Music Forever (40 Brunswick Ave), suggesting the trade moved to Music Forever.
issues.fix: Remove the entry (or convert it to a note on Music Forever); never carry a dead domain in the website field.

issues.claim: Villa Gennaro, 75 Lincoln Hwy - banquet/event venue
issues.problem: Excluded type: it is primarily an Italian restaurant and its private-events page sells per-person food packages, so the entry is a food business. Nothing in the source shows a separately operated venue company.
issues.fix: Remove, or if the event hall is treated as in scope, document the triage decision in notes and cite the private-events page, not just the restaurant site.

issues.claim: Little Treasures Learning Center, 2177 Oak Tree Rd Ste 100, Edison - operating
issues.problem: New Jersey's current licensed child-care list shows Big Blue Marble Academy at the same address and phone, and Big Blue Marble is on the mapper's own excluded-chain list. The entry may describe a business that has been rebranded/acquired. (Inference from the state list, not directly stated as a closure.)
issues.fix: Verify current operator before outreach; drop if the site is now Big Blue Marble Academy.

issues.claim: Hall of Fame Grooming Salon and Doggie Dazzle Rolling Paw Spa - evidence: exa.ai places index URL
issues.problem: The cited URL (exa.ai/library/places?ids=lp8n1j0s4gl) returns only Pawsticcerie - neither grooming business appears on it, so both entries are effectively uncited. Both do exist in Edison per other directories (Hall of Fame at 24 Reed St; Doggie Dazzle is a mobile service listed at 45 Gaskill Ave).
issues.fix: Replace the source URLs with the actual directory pages and mark Doggie Dazzle as mobile (no storefront address).

issues.problem: A chamber-of-commerce profile gives 40 Bloomfield Ave for P.M. Studios with the same phone (732-512-9844); the address in the entry conflicts.
issues.fix: Confirm the storefront address before mailing or visiting.

issues.problem: Sourced only from the city guide and described as 'primarily online' - Russell Ave is a residential street, so this is likely a private home. Listing a residential address risks a privacy violation for a home-based seller.
issues.fix: Keep the business name but blank the street address and note 'online / by appointment only'.
